PROPOSED KOTLIN STDLIB ATTRIBUTION

The inspected historical BuildingWebViewer v1.10.0 APK runtime identifies itself as Kotlin 2.0.21. This is not the final new APK's resolved inventory. Source tag v2.0.21 is commit 284e9b4041bd815b5b1b489070bbb1f1db6de35c.

Kotlin: Copyright JetBrains s.r.o. and Kotlin Programming Language contributors. Apache License 2.0; see KOTLIN-2.0.21-LICENSE.txt.

The upstream license inventory identifies these standard-library portions:
- libraries/stdlib/src/kotlin/collections: derived from GWT, Copyright (C) 2007-08 Google Inc.; Apache 2.0; KOTLIN-GWT-LICENSE.txt.
- libraries/stdlib/jvm/src/kotlin/util/UnsignedJVM.kt: derived from Guava UnsignedLongs, Copyright 2011 The Guava Authors; Apache 2.0; KOTLIN-GUAVA-LICENSE.txt.
- libraries/stdlib/jvm/src/kotlin/util/MathJVM.kt: derived from Boost special math functions, Copyright Eric Ford & Hubert Holin 2001; Boost Software License 1.0; KOTLIN-BOOST-LICENSE.txt.

Exact-version source JAR and upstream repository license inventory are retained in the separate source kit. This notice does not claim Kotlin compiler/test/JS/native-only components were shipped. Final artifact resolution and relevant portions must be reconciled before release. Guava-derived code inside Kotlin does not identify the separate Guava ListenableFuture artifact version.
